scope: Existing source assembly only; not runtime observation or original target execution

fields.name: state_lifetime
fields.observation: optional owned backing lifetime; not a factory

fields.name: configuration
fields.observation: B5/B7/B8/B9/B11 selected19/21; legacy document and KeyForLicense remain

fields.name: files
fields.observation: Runtime default NativeFactory when null; original MSVC file/EH ABI remains unproven

fields.name: input
fields.observation: Runtime default NativeInputPlatform when null; not exercised in B11

fields.name: console
fields.observation: B5 CompilerConsole available via explicit binder; caller must supply before SourceBackend

fields.name: threads
fields.observation: B5/B6 NativeThreads/NativeRuntime available; caller must assemble shared domain and lifetime

fields.name: remaining
fields.observation: mandatory caller Services; B3/B4/B7/B9/B10 selected composition17/17 does not supply all lower foreign resources

fields.name: execution
fields.observation: Runtime default NativeExecution when null; native mutex/cache/concurrency contract remains

fields.name: server
fields.observation: mandatory ServerBackend; SourceBackend executes server algorithms but is not a concrete complete lower network backend

fields.name: online
fields.observation: mandatory lower online Effects; OnlineExecution only binds wait/ready and forwards foreign module/object operations

fields.name: library_os
fields.observation: Runtime default NativeSystemCalls when null; module loading must not be executed in this investigation

fields.name: library_effects
fields.observation: mandatory logging/UI/error lower Effects; LibraryExecution only binds wait/ready; next high-value production boundary

fields.name: host
fields.observation: mandatory host-init Effects including callback/original/provider domain; wrapper does not implement missing foreign ABI

fields.name: hook_cleanup
fields.observation: mandatory lower hook cleanup Effects; source cleanup algorithm and pinned engine fixtures do not install production hooks

fields.name: stop_sources
fields.observation: mandatory external admission stopper; callback wrapper additionally pauses registry but does not stop all source admissions by itself

fields.name: join_api
fields.observation: Runtime chooses native_join_api only if entirely empty; partial API rejected

fields.name: join_timeout_ms
fields.observation: explicit caller policy; no inferred binary default

fields.name: RuntimeSeed and InitialState
fields.observation: all source globals/native defaults caller supplied; no complete shipped image seed or PE entry installed
